## What changed in Phase P1

Implements Phase P1 of the Parent Journey redesign off fresh `origin/dev`:

### 1. `ParentShell` Rebuild (Decision P1 / D-P1)
- **Three Core Destinations:** **This week** (`/parent`), **Children** (`/parent/children`), and **Account** (`/parent/account`).
- **Universal Header:** **Help** (`/parent/help`) is accessible from the header on every page; **Billing** is surfaced inside Account (direct link to `/billing`).
- **Desktop Navigation (≥ 1024px):** 44px minimum touch targets, solid 2px brand outline with soft focus ring (`focus-visible:ring-4`), and Parent role badge.
- **Mobile Bottom Navigation (< 1024px):** Fixed 3-destination bottom bar with 44×44px touch targets (tested 116.7×48.0px), WCAG 2.5.3 compliant labels, and `aria-current="page"`.

### 2. Legacy Route Compatibility & Child-Scoped Subroutes (Requirement 9 & Codex Review)
- **Preserved Legacy `/parent/writing`:** Renders the parent view across all linked children's submitted writing responses without redirecting to an arbitrary single child. Each child section includes a deep link to their dedicated subroute.
- **Preserved Legacy `/parent/curriculum-explorer`:** Renders the Victorian Curriculum Explorer wrapped inside `ParentShell` without redirecting to an arbitrary single child.
- **Child-Scoped Subroutes:**
  - Added `/parent/children/[childId]/curriculum` with year-level focus initialization (resolves Codex finding #4505987894).
  - Added `/parent/children/[childId]/writing` for child-specific writing rubric reviews.
- **Safeguarded `/parent/account`:** Added graceful fallback when Supabase is unconfigured, preventing crashes in disconnected/local preview runs.

### 3. Reusable Primitives & Honesty Rules (§4 of P0 doc)
- **`ChildSwitcher`:** "All children" pill + per-child initial avatar pills; 44px touch targets; `aria-current="page"` on active selection; supports state selection and URL routing.
- **`MarksMeter`:** "X of Y marks" + "N papers · Y marks counted"; purely decorative progress bar marked with `aria-hidden="true"`; **strictly zero percentage symbols (%) and zero performance bands**.
- **`ClaimWithEvidence`:** Evaluative claim headline rendered only when evidence threshold is satisfied (**≥2 finished papers AND ≥8 marks**). Below floor, evaluative claim is suppressed and exact required copy is rendered:
  > *"Not enough yet to say anything about a single strand. It needs 2 finished papers and 8 marks."*
- **Four State Blocks:** `LoadingStateBlock` (`role="status"`), `NothingYetStateBlock` (child fact), `NotEnoughYetStateBlock` (below floor), and `CouldNotLoadStateBlock` (`role="alert"`).

### 4. Isolated Preview Mode Gate (Requirement 8)
- Added `isParentPreviewEnabled()` and `requireParentPreview()` in `src/features/parent-dashboard/preview-mode.ts`.
- Gated to loopback-only requests (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `[::1]`), explicit `PARENT_WORKSPACE_PREVIEW=1`, unconfigured Supabase, and non-Vercel deployments.
- Ensures preview fixtures never stand in for real authenticated accounts.

---

## Verification Evidence
- `npm run typecheck`: **PASS (0 errors)**.
- `npm run lint`: **PASS (0 errors across touched files)**.
- Full Unit Test Suite: **114 tests passed across 11 test suites**:
  - `parent-shell.test.tsx`: 8 passed
  - `parent-shared-primitives.test.tsx`: 14 passed
  - `parent-preview-mode.test.ts`: 6 passed
  - `parent-curriculum-explorer-page.test.tsx`: 6 passed
  - `parent-writing-page.test.tsx`: 3 passed
  - `parent-layout.test.tsx`: 6 passed
  - `parent-child-archive-lifecycle.test.ts`: 21 passed
  - `parent-child-patch-route.test.ts`: 8 passed
  - `parent-children-route.test.ts`: 8 passed
  - `parent-default-child.test.ts`: 18 passed
  - `parent-dashboard-summary.test.ts`: 16 passed
- Next.js Webpack Build: **PASS (all 69 static/dynamic routes compiled cleanly)**.
- Playwright Responsive Verification (Chromium):
  - **Desktop (1440px):** Verified 3-destination desktop nav, Help link, Parent badge, active current page state.
  - **Tablet (834px):** Verified responsive header, wrapping row layout.
  - **Mobile (390px):** Verified fixed bottom navigation bar, 44×44px touch targets (116.7×48.0px effective).
  - Screenshots captured and archived:
    - `account-desktop-1440.png`, `account-tablet-834.png`, `account-mobile-390.png`
    - `help-desktop-1440.png`, `help-tablet-834.png`, `help-mobile-390.png`
    - `curriculum-explorer-desktop-1440.png`, `curriculum-explorer-tablet-834.png`, `curriculum-explorer-mobile-390.png`
